node.statement: Dependency-bearing bridge for the distance comparison: this child depends on nodes 1.2 and 1.1.3 and requires both to be validated. Node 1.2 gives r_star in C. Node 1.1.3 sets D = dist_1(p,C). By definition, dist_1(p,C) is the infimum of ||p-y||_1 over y in C, so every y in C satisfies D <= ||p-y||_1. Taking y = r_star gives D <= ||p-r_star||_1.
